purpose: Document first-party discovery, current viewer configuration, and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: The official Ministry of Land viewer is a real public first-party service relevant to Chandpur. Its current JavaScript was inspected: it uses OpenLayers, a GeoServer WMS/WMTS backend at gis.land.gov.bd, and public POST routes for administrative cascades and plot geometry. A session-backed anonymous point cascade identified the exact WUP point as Chandpur district, Chandpur Sadar, Ward No-12. No owner, address, contact, titleholder, tax, account or personal fields were requested. The GIS backend returned HTTP 503 for capabilities, so no parcel polygon was retained.
registryAssessment: Local/public-service evidence is present through the official Ministry of Land/DLRS viewer and the point-specific Chandpur Sadar Ward No-12 cascade. This is stronger than general agency prose but does not establish a city-maintained cadastral registry or complete public cadastral dataset.

queries.outcome: Official Bengali Ministry of Land viewer and DLRS sources found; the viewer describes mouza/plot mapping and the point cascade identified Chandpur Sadar Ward No-12.

attempts.result: Official viewer loaded; current HTML and JavaScript/configuration inspected.
Initial anonymous request without the viewer session was rejected as expired/page-token mismatch; no credentials or private token used.

Session-backed anonymous level=forDiv/forDist/forThana requests returned WKT administrative boundaries. Point-in-polygon checks identified geocode 201322 Chandpur Sadar and geocode 20132212 Ward No-12 for the exact WUP point.
Official GIS host returned Service Unavailable; no capabilities/schema or parcel-vector response.
Anonymous session-backed official lookup returned Chandpur Sadar thana code 201322 and its 143 public mouza choices. No owner or unsafe record fields requested.

A bounded attempt against the first Chandpur Sadar mouza returned plot WKT and non-personal plot fields into ignored scratch only; the request series was stopped before finding an exact-point parcel. No polygon or source-specific attributes retained.
Official DLRS/Settlement map-search page reviewed; it exposes administrative, mouza, sheet and dag selectors, but no anonymous exact-point parcel geometry was obtained.

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Administrative boundary containment only: exact point falls in Chandpur Sadar Ward No-12. Exact parcel containment was not completed because the GIS capabilities host returned 503 and the parcel route requires UI-derived mouza/table/plot context; this is not evidence of citywide absence.

remainingUncertainty: The WUP point's exact parcel, stable native parcel identifier, parcel CRS response, and citywide coverage remain unverified. The official service may be temporarily unavailable or may require a selected mouza/table context.
runtimeAssessment: not enabled; serial reviewer must independently qualify any adapter
